newsitem.title: GERMANY: Degussa meeting disappoints, shares fall.
newsitem.headline: Degussa meeting disappoints, shares fall.

text.p: German chemical and metals group Degussa AG ended electronic share trade as the biggest loser on Wednesday, after dealers said that an analysts' meeting had been disappointing.
Degussa shares ended afternoon electronic trade at 712.10 marks, down 32.75 marks, compared to the overall IBIS DAX index which ended up 0.87 percent at 3,026.63 points.
Earlier in the day, Degussa shares hit an all-time high of 749.45 marks.
"The figures were good, but the analysts had been expecting more from the meeting," said one trader, while another trader said: "The analysts had problems with the outlook."
